Container.Name: Hermes-Agent

Branch.TagDescription: Laatste stabiele release (semver tags beschikbaar: vX.Y.Z)

Container.Overview: Hermes v2 — stateful, low-noise, AI-assisted autonomous operations agent for Unraid. Beacon observes (primary source), Netdata adds depth, Hermes interprets and acts: incident state machine with debounce/hysteresis, correlation, deterministic runbooks, AI escalation (Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite -> DeepSeek V4 Flash, structured output) and an executor that defaults to DRY-RUN. Notifications are exceptional: final recheck before every Telegram notification. Documentation: https://github.com/Cyxno/hermes-agent#readme NOTE: Beacon's Agent API (unraid-dashboard) must be active with a token (minimum 32 chars) — see docs/MIGRATION.md.

Config.Name: Data (state, config, secrets)
Config.Description: Persistentie: hermes.db, config.yaml, secrets.env. State en historie overleven updates.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for daily summaries and maintenance windows.

Config.Name: Mode (normal|shadow)
Config.Description: shadow = observeert en evalueert volledig, maar verstuurt GEEN meldingen en voert NIETS uit. Zet pas op normal na geslaagde shadow-validatie.

Config.Name: Executor mode (disabled|dry-run|guarded)
Config.Description: disabled = geen acties. dry-run = logt wat hij zou doen. guarded = echte acties, gated door policy + scoped goedkeuring. Verandering vereist bewuste keuze; zie docs/SECURITY.md.

Config.Name: Beacon Agent API token
Config.Description: Bearer token for the Beacon (/api/agent/v1) Agent API of unraid-dashboard. Minimum 32 chars. Same value as AGENT_API_TOKEN in the unraid-dashboard template.

Config.Name: Telegram bot token
Config.Description: Bot token from @BotFather. Prefer a dedicated bot for Hermes v2.

Config.Name: Telegram home chat id
Config.Description: Chat id alerts go to AND commands may come from (private chat = trusted interaction chat; groups also require allowed usernames/user ids).

Config.Name: Telegram allowed usernames
Config.Description: Comma-separated usernames allowed to send commands (e.g. remco). The private home chat is always trusted; groups require this list or user ids.

Config.Name: Telegram allowed user-ids
Config.Description: Comma-separated Telegram user ids (more robust than usernames) allowed to send commands.

Config.Name: OpenRouter API key
Config.Description: For AI diagnosis (Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite, escalation to DeepSeek V4 Flash). Without a key Hermes runs fully deterministic.

Config.Name: Beacon URL
Config.Description: Base URL of Beacon (unraid-dashboard). Use the server LAN address (e.g. http://192.168.1.2:8090); localhost does not work from a bridge container.

Config.Name: Netdata URL
Config.Description: Base URL of Netdata; use the LAN address (e.g. http://192.168.1.2:19999).

Config.Name: Prometheus URL (fallback)
Config.Description: Only for the minimal fallback probe when Beacon is unreachable.

Config.Name: Executor real actions
Config.Description: Master kill switch for guarded real remediation. Default false = dry-run behavior even in guarded mode. Only set true after explicit validation.
